states.name: Chats home
states.purpose: Main hub with a Luzia prompt bar, persona shortcuts, promo cards for Custom Bestie and Toki, and recent chats. Leads to persona chats, the full persona list, the Toki intro, and the Services and Create tabs.

elements.text: How can I help you today?
Make an AI expert tailored to you
Create and take care of your own pet

states.name: Services (Routines empty)
states.purpose: Empty Routines hub explaining that Luzia can shop, book or watch things for the user. Start something opens a routine setup chat; the bell opens notifications.

elements.text: When Luzia shops, books or watches something for you, every update lands here.

states.name: Create – Explore apps
states.purpose: Catalog of AI-made mini apps with a recommended pick and trending cards. User opens an app detail, switches to My Apps, or taps Create app.

states.name: New chat persona picker
states.purpose: Grid of AI personas (Luzia, Teacher, Friend, Chef, Intimate, Adult and more) plus Toki and Custom Bestie. User picks a persona to start a chat.

states.name: Toki intro modal
states.purpose: Modal introducing Toki, a virtual pet that grows when cared for. User taps Meet me or Later, or closes it.

elements.text: Tok-Tok! I'm Toki and I need your help!
I want to grow and become as powerful as Luzia. Care for me to see me grow!
You can turn me on & off anytime in Settings.

states.name: Teacher chat thread
states.purpose: Existing chat with the Teacher persona where the user types or records messages and gets AI replies with feedback, copy, read aloud and share actions.

elements.text: Hello, I'm Teacher. Ask me for advice, answers, or let's talk about whatever you want. What would you like to talk about today?
Hello, what would you like to know? Remember that sometimes my answer may not be exact.

elements.label: Audio Button: Tap twice or hold to record. Slide up for hands-free mode, left to cancel. Release to send.

elements.text: Luzia is AI and can make mistakes. Verify important information.

states.name: Custom Bestie intro
states.purpose: Intro screen for creating a personalized AI companion. Let's get started begins creation; close returns home.

elements.text: Personalize your unique friend and discover everything they can do for you.

states.name: Routine setup chat
states.purpose: Chat with Luzia to set up a background routine such as a price watch, briefing or date reminder, via suggestion chips or free text.

elements.text: Hi! I can set up a routine that quietly works in the background for you: watching a price until it drops, sending you a daily briefing, or reminding you before an important date. What would you like me to keep an eye on?
Watch a price, event or product

elements.label: Audio Button: Tap twice or hold to record. Slide up for hands-free mode, left to cancel. Release to send.

states.name: Services (routines list)
states.purpose: Routines hub showing active routines, here one draft, with an Add new Routine button.

states.name: Notifications – Services tab
states.purpose: Notifications screen with Updates, Services and Activity tabs; the Services tab lists routines and offers Add new Routine.

states.name: Create app prompt
states.purpose: User describes an app idea by text or voice, or picks a template to remix; creations become public once published.

elements.text: Start with an idea or remix.
I want to make a chaotic mini-game where you tap to keep a llama from escaping.
Luzia is AI and can make mistakes. Creations are public once published.

states.name: Create – My Apps
states.purpose: The user's own apps list, empty here, with a Create app button and a switch back to Explore.

states.name: App detail
states.purpose: Detail page of a community mini app (Photoedit) with Open app, like and save counts, share, remix and report.

states.name: Create – Explore scrolled
states.purpose: Scrolled Explore catalog showing trending apps with counts and category filters (Hot, New, Creative, Arcade, Tools) over game cards.

states.name: Teacher new chat
states.purpose: Fresh chat with the Teacher persona showing its greeting; the user types or records a question.

elements.text: Hello! I am Teacher, your personal tutor. I'm here to resolve your doubts, clarify those difficult concepts, and guide you in your learning journey. Every day is an opportunity to learn something new. Which topic would you like to delve into today?

elements.label: Audio Button: Tap twice or hold to record. Slide up for hands-free mode, left to cancel. Release to send.

elements.text: Luzia is AI and can make mistakes. Verify important information.

flows.name: Continue a chat and get a reply
flows.purpose: Core loop: open a recent chat, type a message, send it, and receive an AI reply.

flows.name: Browse personas and start a persona chat
flows.purpose: Open the full persona list, return home, and start a chat with Teacher from the home shortcut.

flows.name: Set up a routine
flows.purpose: Go to Services and start a background routine (price watch, briefing, reminder) through a setup chat.

flows.name: Explore and create mini apps
flows.purpose: Open the Create tab, view a community app's detail, return, and start creating an app from a prompt.

flows.name: Meet Toki virtual pet
flows.purpose: Open the Toki promo card to see the virtual pet intro modal.

flows.name: Create a Custom Bestie
flows.purpose: Open the Custom Bestie promo to start building a personalized AI companion.

mechanics.summary: No message limit, paywall, or ad appeared in 3 passes of sending chat messages; plan of the account was not recorded, so a limit may exist beyond that.
Toki virtual pet that grows when the user cares for it, an engagement and return-visit hook promoted on home.
Custom Bestie lets users build a personalized AI companion; promoted on home and in the persona picker.
Routines: Luzia runs background tasks (price watching, daily briefings, reminders, shopping or booking) and posts updates to Services.
User-generated mini app platform: users create apps by prompt or Remix an existing app, published creations are public, and apps are ranked with like and save counts.
